text.p: Financial services group ING Groep NV (ING) said on Thursday that provisions in 1997 for the euro currency would be similar to 1996, which were about one third of total 1996 provisions of 530 million guilders.
"We do not know yet how high the provisions for other matters will be, but 1997 provisions for the euro will be similar to those in 1996," ING spokesman Ruud Polet told Reuters.
The other expenses included in the 1996 provisions included information technology, reorganisations and the millennium.
Polet was clarifying a remark made by executive board chairman Aad Jacobs at a news conference on the group's 1996 results.
Asked about provisions in 1997, Jacobs had said: "Provisions will be similar or just a little bit lower (than in 1996)."
